column1: # Golden Sun: Ashfall: Umbral Rift live narrative dialogue.
# Split into speech turns; each page max three lines, each line max 27 characters.
# ??? remains unidentified. Mia never calls Alex a cousin.

column3: That monolith...\nIt wasn't here before.{end_wait}
And it's right by Vale.\nWhat is this place?{end_wait}
The fountain...\nMercury Lighthouse?{end_wait}
We're nowhere near Imil.{end_wait}
I know. But the shape\nis exactly the same.{end_wait}
The stone is different.\nDarker. Almost violet.{end_wait}
Two people.\nBy the arch.{end_wait}
Did you see that?\nThey were right there!{end_wait}
And that statue...\nIts Psynergy feels wrong.{end_wait}
Let's see where\nthe arch leads.{end_wait}
These passages...{end_wait}
Sol Sanctum.\nI know that turn.{end_wait}
But we just left\nMercury Lighthouse.{end_wait}
There should be a hall\nto our right.{end_wait}
There's only a wall.{end_wait}
It's the same pattern,\nbut these rooms don't fit.{end_wait}
There they are again.{end_wait}
Gone again! How do\nthey keep doing that?{end_wait}
Stay close.\nWe don't know what\nthis place is doing.{end_wait}
Wait.\nThis is my house.{end_wait}
Even the front room...\nIt looks like home.{end_wait}
How could it be here?{end_wait}
I almost called\nfor Mom.{end_wait}
So did I.{end_wait}
That orb is pulsing.\nLike the fountain statue.{end_wait}
Perhaps it's connected.{end_wait}
Then we should\ntake a closer look.{end_wait}
The orb is changing.{end_wait}
Its Psynergy is flowing\ntoward the fountain.{end_wait}
Something opened.\nDid you feel that?{end_wait}
Back to the fountain.\nLet's see what changed.{end_wait}
That light wasn't here.{end_wait}
The orb opened the seal.\nThere's a path ahead.{end_wait}
Those two went this way.\nOf course they did.{end_wait}
Then we follow.{end_wait}
The ground's shaking!\nHold on!{end_wait}
It stopped...\nWhat was that?{end_wait}
The passage is unstable.\nWe shouldn't stay long.{end_wait}
Those two are ahead.\nLet's find out why\nthey came here.{end_wait}
We followed you here.\nWhy are you in this place?{end_wait}
I recognized its power.\nI came to see\nwhat crossed over.{end_wait}
We saw a lighthouse,\nSol Sanctum, my home.\nNone of it fits.{end_wait}
No. It doesn't.{end_wait}
Then they're not illusions?{end_wait}
Touch the walls.\nThey are real enough.{end_wait}
Where did they come from?{end_wait}
Another world.\nFragments of places\nit once held.{end_wait}
What brought them here?{end_wait}
A passage between worlds\nwas opened.\nIt didn't close cleanly.{end_wait}
And the light\nby the fountain?{end_wait}
It holds the breach\nin one place.\nFor now.{end_wait}
What if it fails?{end_wait}
The Rift may spread.\nVale could be next.{end_wait}
Then close it.{end_wait}
Not yet.\nI need to know\nif it can be used.{end_wait}
Used for what?{end_wait}
A way across worlds.\nMy people once had one.{end_wait}
Why bring Heart?{end_wait}
Her Dark Psynergy\ncan sense weak points.\nI need her for that.{end_wait}
We saw you in the halls.\nYou kept disappearing.{end_wait}
You saw where we had been.\nThe Rift kept an echo.{end_wait}
Matthew...{end_wait}
Heart. My name is Isaac.{end_wait}
Don't lie to me!\nI know those eyes!{end_wait}
You ruined my face!\nI can't even bear\nmy own reflection!{end_wait}
I'll kill you!\nI'll make you suffer!{end_wait}
Heart. Stay where you are.{end_wait}
My lady, please!\nLet me kill him!{end_wait}
I said stay.{end_wait}
He took everything!{end_wait}
And you're about\nto disobey me again.{end_wait}
I'll tear him apart!{end_wait}
Do you remember\nwhy I brought you here?{end_wait}
To hold the passage.\nMy lady, please...{end_wait}
Because your power\nis still useful to me.\nNot because I trust you.{end_wait}
My lady...{end_wait}
At the Apollo Lens,\nMatthew was to live.\nThat was my order.{end_wait}
But Ace betrayed us!{end_wait}
Do you really think\nI didn't know?{end_wait}
You... knew?{end_wait}
Ace was Alex.\nHe fooled the others.\nHe never fooled me.{end_wait}
...Alex?{end_wait}
Did you say Alex?{end_wait}
Kraden exposed his name\nat the Apollo Lens.\nI knew long before.{end_wait}
Kraden was there?{end_wait}
How do you know them?{end_wait}
I'm speaking to Heart.{end_wait}
I knew Alex would turn.\nI was ready for him.{end_wait}
Then you and Spade\ntried to seize the Lens.\nFor yourselves.{end_wait}
We meant to stop him!{end_wait}
You meant to take it.\nDon't insult me\nwith another lie!{end_wait}
My lady...{end_wait}
You forced a battle\nI never ordered.\nAlex escaped.{end_wait}
You threw away\nmy chance to deal with him.\nDo you understand?{end_wait}
Yes, my lady!\nI'm sorry!{end_wait}
Then why do you\nstill blame Matthew?{end_wait}
He ruined my face!{end_wait}
He fought back.\nYou chose that fight.\nYou chose to betray me.{end_wait}
Please... I beg you...{end_wait}
When I learned what\nyou and Spade had done,\nI nearly killed you both.{end_wait}
No...\nPlease, my lady!{end_wait}
I should have.{end_wait}
Please don't kill me!\nI'll obey! I swear it!{end_wait}
You are alive because\nyou are still useful.\nThat is the only reason.{end_wait}
That can change\nin an instant.{end_wait}
Know your place, Heart.\nOr you will die.{end_wait}
Forgive me!\nPlease forgive me!\nI'll never fail again!{end_wait}
Get up.{end_wait}
Y-yes, my lady...{end_wait}
Enough.\nYou said Alex and Kraden.{end_wait}
Alex abandoned our clan.\nHe helped light\nMercury Lighthouse.{end_wait}
Now you speak of him\nbetraying you, too.\nAnd Kraden was there?{end_wait}
We know nothing\nabout this Apollo Lens.{end_wait}
At Vale, you warned me\nabout thirty years.{end_wait}
Is this about\nour future?{end_wait}
Not every world\nfollows the same road.{end_wait}
Then what happened\nto Alex?{end_wait}
You've heard more\nthan I intended.{end_wait}
You said he escaped.\nWhere did he go?{end_wait}
I will not tell you.{end_wait}
You can't expect me\nto forget his name!{end_wait}
I don't expect you to.{end_wait}
Forgive me, my lady...{end_wait}
Quiet, Heart.\nYou've done enough.{end_wait}
...Yes.{end_wait}
Then we'll find out.\nBut first, the Rift.{end_wait}
If you keep it open,\nVale could disappear.{end_wait}
I need this passage\nlong enough to learn\nhow to open one safely.{end_wait}
Not at Vale's expense.\nWe're closing it.{end_wait}
You won't reach the anchor\nwhile I still stand here.{end_wait}
My lady...\nYour orders?{end_wait}
Stand beside me, Heart.\nAnd Isaac lives.{end_wait}
Yes, my lady.\nI won't fail you.{end_wait}
You'd better not.{end_wait}
Everyone, together.{end_wait}
It's over.\nLet us close the Rift.{end_wait}
I won't fight again.\nI've learned enough\nfrom this breach.{end_wait}
Enough for what?{end_wait}
To know what failed.\nAnd what comes next.{end_wait}
My lady... We lost.\nPlease, I obeyed you!{end_wait}
You obeyed this time.\nThat does not erase\nthe Apollo Lens.{end_wait}
I know, my lady.\nPlease...{end_wait}
Stand up.\nDo not make me ask twice.{end_wait}
Yes! Right away!{end_wait}
If we seal that light,\nwhat happens to the rooms?{end_wait}
They may remain.\nBut nothing new\nwill be drawn in.{end_wait}
And Vale?{end_wait}
Safe from this opening.\nNot from every Rift.{end_wait}
You said Alex escaped.\nWhere is he now?{end_wait}
That is not\nyour answer to have.{end_wait}
He abandoned Imil.\nAnd you know\nwhat became of him.{end_wait}
There is more to learn.\nI won't tell it for him.{end_wait}
And the Grave Eclipse?\nYou said thirty years.{end_wait}
My warning stands.\nDon't mistake this Rift\nfor the end of it.{end_wait}
My lady...\nAre we leaving?{end_wait}
Yes, Heart.\nYou've done enough here.{end_wait}
I understand.{end_wait}
I won't have this\nconversation again.{end_wait}
You won't.\nI swear it.{end_wait}
You still haven't\ntold me who you are.{end_wait}
No.\nThirty years, Isaac.{end_wait}
The light's still active.\nWe have to stop it.{end_wait}
The orb opened its seal.\nThat same path\nis still connected.{end_wait}
The power's moving\ntoward the walls.{end_wait}
Can we turn it back?{end_wait}
I think so.\nThe seal already exists.\nWe only need to close it.{end_wait}
Then do it.\nWe're right here.{end_wait}
It's going dark!{end_wait}
The pull has stopped.{end_wait}
The rooms remain.\nBut nothing else\nis coming through.{end_wait}
Then Vale is safe.\nFor now.{end_wait}
Isaac... About Alex.{end_wait}
I haven't forgotten.{end_wait}
She knew the name Ace.\nAnd Kraden was there.\nShe spoke like it happened.{end_wait}
Whatever world she knew,\nit wasn't ours.{end_wait}
Not yet, anyway.{end_wait}
We don't know\nwhat our future holds.\nLet's tell the elders.{end_wait}
And I won't forget Alex.{end_wait}
Neither will I.\nLet's go home.{end_wait}
